Title: Vihaan and the Family

Cast

1. Vihaan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anita - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Rishabh - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
4. Riya - 9 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Ananya - 11 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Ananya stand near him.]

Vihaan: "What lovely weather!"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Vihaan: "Let's see."

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Ananya: "That's great!"

[Flower petals rain down on Vihaan.]

Anita: "Exactly right."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Vihaan (softly): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Anita: "That's easy."

[Vihaan lights a bonfire.]

Anita (surprised): "Ananya, listen!"

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

Riya: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan makes tea for everyone.]

Riya: "Show me too!"

[Vihaan chops onions for the curry.]

Anita (happily): "Vihaan, are you okay?"

[Vihaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Anita: "That was such a fun day!"
